fee_notes: Royalty is tiered based on calendar year-to-date Gross Revenues Collected: 6% on $0-$1,000,000; 5% on $1,000,001-$3,000,000; 4% on $3,000,001-$5,000,000; 3% on $5,000,001-$7,000,000; 2% on $7,000,001+. Minimum Royalty is $500/month beginning on the one-year anniversary of the Effective Date; can increase up to 10% per year after year 5. Brand Fund Contribution currently not assessed. Local Advertising Expenditure Requirement: greater of $2,000/month or 5% of monthly Gross Revenues Collected (after initial $20,000 spend in first 90 days); deficiency paid to franchisor if not met. Additional ongoing monthly fees: Accounting Services Fee $499/month (plus setup fee of $440); Contact Center Fee $200-$300/month; Digital Management Fee $500/month; Special Software Fee $300/month.

Royalty Fee | The greater of (i) Royalty Percentage of Gross Revenues; or (ii) the Minimum Royalty Fee. | Monthly via Electronic Funds Transfer from your bank account. | See Note 1 / See Note 2 for Minimum Royalty Fee structure

Local Advertising Deficiency | Payable only if you fail to perform the Local Advertising Expenditure Requirement. Thereafter, on a monthly basis, the greater of either: (i) $2,000 per month; or (ii) 5% of your monthly Gross Revenues Collected, on Local Advertising Expenditure Requirement. | As incurred. | See Note 16
Royalty Tier Table: Tier 1: $0-$1,000,000 = 6%; Tier 2: $1,000,001-$3,000,000 = 5%; Tier 3: $3,000,001-$5,000,000 = 4%; Tier 4: $5,000,001-$7,000,000 = 3%; Tier 5: $7,000,001 and above = 2%. Minimum Royalty: $500 per month beginning on one-year anniversary of Effective Date.
